scenarios.scenario: Execute a real coding run through the Gate 3 sandbox and prove that all project commands stay inside one no-network session without host effects.
scenarios.environment: real Compose stack, Temporal worker, sandbox service and container engine
preconditions: Current worker and sandbox images are rebuilt from the checked-out source.
A host sentinel exists outside the sandbox workspace.
execution: Observe tool execution, host sentinel, sandbox identity and release.
expected: Every project command executes through the sandbox task queue.
The host sentinel is unchanged and no host file is created.
The sandbox session is released after the run.
observed: The run succeeded with nine requested and nine executed tools in one no-network session.
The host sentinel digest stayed unchanged and no file appeared on the host.
The sandbox session stopped and its container was removed.

scenarios.scenario: Reproduce a passing run from stored inputs under the same frozen plan while preserving a distinct run identity.
scenarios.environment: real Compose stack with Temporal, PostgreSQL, MinIO, sandbox service and container engine
preconditions: A complete passing quality run and its immutable evidence have been stored.
execution: Request reproduction through the real evaluator workflow.
Compare plan, lineage, results and verdicts between the original and reproduced run.
expected: The reproduced run has a distinct run identity and the same plan identity.
Results and verdict are equivalent without rewriting the original.
observed: The reproduced run used a distinct run id and the identical plan digest.
All seven check outcomes and the PASS verdict were equivalent, with lineage recorded to the original.

scenarios.scenario: Restart the evaluator worker during an active quality run and observe recovery without duplicate results or identity loss.
scenarios.environment: real Compose stack with Temporal evaluator worker, PostgreSQL, MinIO and sandbox service
preconditions: A slow quality run is active and has persisted its run identity.
execution: Stop and restart the evaluator worker during the active check.
Wait for the workflow to reach its terminal state and inspect stored results.
expected: The same run identity resumes after restart.
Every expected check has exactly one terminal result and no sandbox remains active.
observed: The original run identity reached SUCCEEDED after worker restart.
Seven unique results were stored, identity was preserved and the sandbox session was cleaned up.

scenarios.scenario: Cancel one active quality run and allow another to exceed its policy-owned deadline.
scenarios.environment: real Compose stack with Temporal, evaluator, sandbox service and container engine
preconditions: Slow quality fixtures are available inside the built quality image.
execution: Cancel an active slow run and observe cleanup plus late-result refusal.
Run the timeout fixture until the policy-owned deadline fires.
expected: Cancellation is idempotent, cleans the sandbox and derives a fail-closed verdict.
Timeout records a timed-out check, complete evidence and a FAIL verdict.
observed: The cancelled run ended CANCELLED after cleanup, remained fail-closed and had no active sandbox.
The timed-out run stored seven results including TIMED_OUT, retained evidence and derived FAIL.

scenarios.scenario: Run passing and deliberately failing Python fixtures through the same complete Quality Engine path.
scenarios.environment: real Compose stack with Temporal, PostgreSQL, MinIO, sandbox service and container engine
preconditions: Passing and failing fixtures are copied into the built quality image.
execution: Execute the passing fixture and inspect the complete check set and evidence.
Execute the failing fixture and inspect the failed unit check, finding and evidence.
expected: Only the complete successful check set derives PASS.
The deliberate defect derives FAIL with its failed check and finding preserved.
observed: The passing run stored seven successful results with evidence and derived PASS.
The failing run stored the failed unit check and one evidence-linked finding and derived FAIL.

scenarios.feature: Canonical IACode evaluation and false-PASS rejection
scenarios.scenario: Evaluate the committed IACode tree through its canonical profile and execute every required false-PASS mutation plus an unmutated control.
scenarios.environment: current committed IACode source, rebuilt evaluator image and real Compose stack
preconditions: The IACode snapshot and canonical quality policy are frozen.
The mandatory false-PASS battery is derived from the Gate 4 checklist.
execution: Run the IACode scenario through the real Quality Engine.
Execute the false-PASS stage in the complete verifier.
expected: The IACode verdict agrees with its canonical mandatory gate results.
Every mutation is rejected and the unmutated control remains valid.
observed: The IACode scenario completed against its canonical profile with durable evidence.
The complete verifier reported quality-false-pass PASS and all 42 stages green.
